params.prompt: Bold, simple, instantly readable mobile app ad visual, 4:5 vertical. Solid saturated flat background with subtle radial glow, nothing else in the scene. The hero group sits in the center (35%-82% height). Upper 30% of frame completely empty, bottom 15% completely empty. No text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no people except the mascot, no money. Clean premium 3D render. Include the cute 3D mascot from the reference image (Meri: big round fluffy orange petal-shaped hair like a flower, round peach face with rosy cheeks, red sweater with white letter M), drawn SMALL (about 25% of the hero group height) as a supporting accent, not the main subject. Hero object: three glossy 3D award podium blocks of different heights, the tall white ones topped with simple faceless white figure tokens, and the lowest red block on the right with Meri standing on it looking up at the tall ones; a big red notification badge with a question mark symbol above Meri. Background: vivid yellow-orange.
